_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 28: 2025-10-24 to 2025-10-27. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they do not pray it will break forth in these cities worse than the BLM riots, and that he saw people stealing from department stores.
mentions.quote: if we don't pray break forth in these cities with worse than the BLM
mentions.falsify_match: Rioting and looting in US cities exceeding 2020.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw martial law in these cities with people unable to come out, that he saw it back in 2024, that there is now an opportunity for that vision to come to pass on Saturday, and that they pray it does not.
mentions.quote: I saw martial law taking place in all these cities, you couldn't come out
mentions.falsify_match: Martial law declared in American cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to prayer in the same sentence.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that faith works by love, so bitterness and strife in a marriage hinders it, and that husbands who do not honour their wives have their prayers hindered.
mentions.quote: your prayers being hindered if you're not honoring your wives
mentions.condition_text: answered prayer conditioned on the state of the marriage
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: another clause that assigns unanswered prayer to the hearer.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears in part, does not know the timing of things, is trying to pray into it, and that he is just human like everyone watching.
mentions.quote: you're hearing a part, you you don't know timing of things
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and one of the plainer admissions: he hears in part and does not know the timing.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees cotton white with harvest and reads John 4:35, that you should not say there are four months to harvest but lift up your eyes because the fields are white already.
mentions.quote: I see cotton. It's white with harvest
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the harvest declared already ripe rather than dated.

mentions.claim_text: He warns that churches will be decimated and that a congregation of over ten thousand will be there one moment and gone the next.
mentions.quote: they'll be there one moment and they'll be gone
mentions.falsify_match: Large congregations collapsing suddenly.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is not just about America but about the whole world, and asks whether they understand.
mentions.quote: And you think it's just about America? This is about around the world
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scope framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be a shaking in the Catholic church, and that this is why he saw the volcano, with a major shaking cracking even the doors and walls of the cathedral.
mentions.quote: a major shaking will crack even the doors and the walls of the Cat
mentions.falsify_match: Structural damage to a major Catholic cathedral from an earthquake or eruption.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This links italy-volcano to the church thread for the first time.

mentions.claim_text: He says what happens over the temples is going to be really out there, that he does not throw anything past where they are now, and that since 23 September the Lord said a great acceleration.
mentions.quote: as of the September 23rd that a great accel
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable acceleration of events since 23 September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether Atlas is supposed to do something around the sun and whether they are getting close to that event, and whether it is supposed to happen this week.
mentions.quote: Is Atlas supposed to Something around the sun
mentions.falsify_match: The 3I/ATLAS perihelion is a real dated astronomical event; he is asking about it rather than foreseeing it.

mentions.claim_text: He says a lot of people are naming 29 and 31 October so it is this week, and wonders whether it will start to do something really big.
mentions.quote: I see a lot of people saying October 29th and October 31st
mentions.falsify_match: Not his dates; other people's, which he repeats without endorsing.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a wild open-eyed vision that a great deception is coming, says they have never seen what they are about to see, and asks the Lord what it is.
mentions.quote: a great deception's coming. And I go, we've never seen what we're about to see
mentions.falsify_match: A deception event of unprecedented scale, most likely the alien or disclosure kind he has described.

mentions.claim_text: He says the thing starts talking and asks whether it is fallen angel material, that he keeps praying into it, and that he does not talk about it because he does not understand it yet and does not want to bring it out wrongly.
mentions.quote: I don't understand it yet and I don't want to brin
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is restraint worth recording: he withholds material he does not understand.

mentions.claim_text: He tells people to take heed to the instructions of what they have been called to do and to boldly come up higher with the fire.
mentions.quote: Come up higher. Come up higher with the fire
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is more to it and it is bigger than drugs, that they are talking about going in and attacking their camps, and repeats that he saw Venezuela coming to the aid of Russia with oil.
mentions.quote: It's bigger than drugs
mentions.falsify_match: A US ground operation in Venezuela with oil and Russia as the real drivers.

mentions.claim_text: He replays the clip of people with signs demanding entitlements, welfare and food stamps because all of it was cut off.
mentions.quote: We want our entitlements, our welfare, food stamps
mentions.falsify_match: Replayed twice in a week during the SNAP funding lapse.

mentions.claim_text: The clip continues: people pillaging stores, tearing up downtown areas, major shopping areas and malls, breaking all the glass out and grabbing whatever they wanted.
mentions.quote: they were pillaging stores. They were going and tearing up all of the downtown
mentions.falsify_match: Mass looting of malls and downtown districts.

mentions.claim_text: He dates the original to 7 April 2024, well over a year before, and answers the charge that he is trying to stir up fear by saying he is not worried and has never seen the righteous forsaken.
mentions.quote: trying to stir up fear on me, Brandon? No. I ain't worried about it
mentions.falsify_match: The citation is accurate; the original is in this corpus at dq4Jz74Kpfw@911.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the oil press and the olives and what is about to take place, but that he is so focused on what the Lord said about heavenly music that nothing else matters to him.
mentions.quote: the oil press. I saw the olives. I saw what's about to take place
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the content of what he saw is withheld in favour of the music.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that the viewer's house will be paid in full by the end of 2025 through supernatural debt cancellation, and says God is as big as your faith allows and could use crypto or anything else.
mentions.quote: house will be paid in full by the end of 2025 for supernatural debt cancellation
mentions.condition_text: as big as your faith will allow him to be
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable at corpus level, and the faith clause absorbs any individual failure.

mentions.claim_text: He says he felt led to say that by the end of 2025, the next nine weeks, the viewer will be completely debt free, and acknowledges it might annoy some of them.
mentions.quote: the end of 2025, the next 9 weeks, you're going to be completely debt free
mentions.falsify_match: A dated financial promise with a hard deadline, unusually specific for this material.
mentions.falsify_miss: Viewers are not debt free by 31 December 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says people take the Jericho march and pull the walls down but are not grateful for what God did do, and that you have to be thankful either way.
mentions.quote: you wasn't grateful that you that for what he did do
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He cites making a joyful noise and shouting with a voice of triumph, and says the Lord told him today he was going to give him something, which is where it all stemmed from.
mentions.quote: Brandon, I'm going to give you something
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord keeps talking about a major change within a twenty four hour period, that a major shaking is coming and everything ever known will change, and ties it back to what he was told on 23 September.
mentions.quote: He keeps talking about a 24-hour change. A major change within a 24-hour period
mentions.falsify_match: A single transformative day.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and the claim has carried no date since September 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether viewers know Jesus or only know about him, and whether he knows them, pointing at the inward tug and stirring they are feeling.
mentions.quote: you may know a lot about him, but does he know you?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal.

mentions.claim_text: He models refusing the evidence of symptoms: he is not moved by what he sees or feels, he is still healed though still coughing and his throat is sore, and still saved though he stubbed his toe and swore.
mentions.quote: WELL, YOU'RE STILL COUGHING. YOUR THROAT WAS SORE. WELL, I'M STILL HEALED
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and this is the clearest statement of why: symptoms are defined in advance as not counting against the claim of healing.
